# The questionnaire as a map

**What this is.** A picture of every route a partner can take through the questionnaire, made by the same engine the phones run (`web/js/flow.js`), so it cannot disagree with the form.

- **Source:** `web/config/survey.json`, config_version `2026-10-19.1`, graph format `pp-flow/1`.
- **Regenerate it** after every change to the flow (Terminal, in the project folder): `python3 scripts/flow.py map --write`.
- **Check it:** `python3 scripts/flow.py check`. **Try answers:** `python3 scripts/flow.py simulate --set nps=4 --set support_gate=no`.
- How the flow format works: [flow-engine.md](flow-engine.md); in plain English: [config-guide.md](config-guide.md).

## 1. Before the questionnaire (fixed, in the form's code)

These checks are security rules, so they stay in `web/js/app.js` and no settings change can skip them.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A(["Partner opens the link"])
  B{"Does the link have dc, t and round?"}
  X1[["Message: this link is incomplete"]]
  C["Load the questionnaire published in the control panel<br/>(the form#39;s own copy if Google does not answer in time)"]
  D{"Round status?"}
  X2[["Message: this survey is not open yet"]]
  X3[["Message: this survey has closed"]]
  E{"On this phone ..."}
  X4[["Message: your answers were already received"]]
  X5[["Thank-you screen: sends the answers again"]]
  X6[["Message: this link is not valid"]]
  F(["The questionnaire below: its start,<br/>or where the partner left off"])
  A --> B
  B -->|"no"| X1
  B -->|"yes"| C
  C --> D
  D -->|"draft"| X2
  D -->|"closed, nothing started or unsent on this phone"| X3
  D -->|"open, or closed but started on this phone"| E
  E -->|"already sent"| X4
  E -->|"finished but not sent"| X5
  E -->|"refused before"| X6
  E -->|"otherwise"| F
  F -.->|"Google answers the opened message: wrong token"| X6
```

## 2. The questionnaire

Boxes are screens, diamonds are "only if" rules (a "no" skips the screen), labelled arrows are jumps, framed boxes are loops, round boxes are endings (they send the answers).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  START(["Partner opens the link (after the checks above)"])
  START --> n_language_if
  n_language_if{"only if the link has no ?lang="}
  n_language_if -->|yes| n_language
  n_language_if -.->|"no: skipped"| n_whats_changed_if
  n_language["<b>Language buttons</b><br/>Choose your language<br/><small>language</small>"]
  n_language --> n_whats_changed_if
  n_whats_changed_if{"only if the round has #quot;what changed#quot; items"}
  n_whats_changed_if -->|yes| n_whats_changed
  n_whats_changed_if -.->|"no: skipped"| n_nps
  n_whats_changed["<b>#quot;What changed#quot; card</b><br/>What changed since your last feedback<br/><small>whats_changed</small>"]
  n_whats_changed --> n_nps
  n_nps["<b>0-10 question</b><br/>How likely are you to recommend Valmo to another DC owner?<br/><small>nps</small>"]
  n_nps --> n_fn_ratings
  subgraph L_fn_ratings ["For each area (6: losses, payments, linehaul, consumables, orders, app)"]
    n_fn_ratings["<b>Area rating (faces)</b><br/>How is your experience with this?<br/><small>fn_rating:#123;area#125;</small>"]
  end
  n_fn_ratings --> n_fn_deep_dives
  subgraph L_fn_deep_dives ["For each area (6: losses, payments, linehaul, consumables, orders, app) where fn_rating:#123;area#125; #lt;= area.threshold"]
    n_fn_deep_dives["<b>Main problem + tell us more</b><br/>What is the main problem?<br/><small>fn_deep_dive:#123;area#125;</small>"]
  end
  n_fn_deep_dives --> n_support_gate
  n_support_gate["<b>Yes / No question</b><br/>In the last 30 days, did you contact Valmo support?<br/><small>support_gate</small>"]
  n_support_gate --> n_support_if
  n_support_if{"only if support_gate == yes"}
  n_support_if -->|yes| n_support
  n_support_if -.->|"no: skipped"| n_one_fix
  n_support["<b>Support ratings</b><br/>How was your last contact with Valmo support?<br/><small>support</small>"]
  n_support --> n_one_fix
  n_one_fix["<b>Voice or typing</b><br/>If Valmo could fix just one thing for you, what should it be?<br/><small>one_fix</small>"]
  n_one_fix --> n_thanks
  n_thanks(["<b>Ending</b><br/>Thank you!<br/><small>thanks: sends the answers</small>"])
```

## 3. Every screen

| Code | Kind | Question (English) | Shown | Then | Answers stored as |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `language` | Language buttons | Choose your language | only if the link has no ?lang= | whats_changed | — |
| `whats_changed` | "What changed" card | What changed since your last feedback | only if the round has "what changed" items | nps | — |
| `nps` | 0-10 question | How likely are you to recommend Valmo to another DC owner? | always | fn_ratings | `nps` |
| `fn_ratings` | Area rating (faces) | How is your experience with this? | for each area (6) | fn_deep_dives | `fn_rating:{area}` |
| `fn_deep_dives` | Main problem + tell us more | What is the main problem? | for each area (6) where fn_rating:{area} &lt;= area.threshold | support_gate | `fn_deep_dive:{area}` |
| `support_gate` | Yes / No question | In the last 30 days, did you contact Valmo support? | always | support | `support_gate` |
| `support` | Support ratings | How was your last contact with Valmo support? | only if support_gate == yes | one_fix | `support:{item}` (4 items), `support_comment` |
| `one_fix` | Voice or typing | If Valmo could fix just one thing for you, what should it be? | always | thanks | `one_fix` |
| `thanks` | Thank you (sends the answers) | Thank you! | always | the end: sends the answers | — |
